String.string:
[EN] Stick with It
[ES] Insiste con eso
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Popori...? Lime! Right, I'll get some lime."
[ES] "¿Popori...? ¡Cal. De acuerdo, conseguiré un poco de cal."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Keezar.
[ES] Habla con Keezar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "All right."
[ES] "De acuerdo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect lime deposits around Hina Hot Springs.
[ES] Recolecta depósitos de cal alrededor de Hina Hot Springs.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring lime deposits to Keezar.
[ES] Lleva los depósitos de cal a Keezar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Is he as crazy as you are?"
[ES] "¿Él está tan loco como tú?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Keezar how long it will take.
[ES] Pregúntale a Keezar cuánto tiempo tomará.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Making Stick-It-All
[ES] Haciendo pegamento mágico
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Show Keezar's memo to her right hand man.
[ES] Muéstrale la nota de Keezar a su mano derecha.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "That's all?"
[ES] "¿Eso es todo?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Spirit's Tear
[ES] Lágri de espíritu
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Parthian shamans on Freedomhill for Spirit's Tears.
[ES] Mata chamanes parthian en Freedomhill para conseguir lágrimas de espíritu.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Spirit's Tears to Keezar's right hand.
[ES] Lleva las lágrimas de espíritu a la mano derecha de Keezar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll just leave you to it, then."
[ES] "Mejor te dejo con esto, entonces."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "That's it? It's done?"
[ES] "¿Eso es todo? ¿Ya está hecho?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Dandit if he's finished.
[ES] Pregúntale a Dandit si ha terminado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use Keezar's "power glue" to fix the broken archdevan pendant.
[ES] Usa el "superpegamento" de Keezar para reparar el colgante archdevan roto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Restored Archdevan Control Pendant.
[ES] Colgante de control archdevan restaurado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I know them. Thanks for your help!"
[ES] "Los conozco. ¡Gracias por tu ayuda!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Show restored Archdevan Control Pendant to Dandit.
[ES] Muéstrale el colgante de control archidevo restaurado a Dandit.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
